profile.name: Nayem Siddiki
profile.intro: I am Nayem Siddiki, a CSE undergraduate student at the American International University–Bangladesh (AIUB), passionate about mathematics and scientific research. My interests include machine learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and algorithmic problem-solving. Currently, I am exploring fluid mechanics using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and conducting research on quantum droplets, with a focus on the intersection of artificial intelligence, applied mathematics, and quantum physics.

projects.title: Khoja-Khuji: A Lost and Found Management System Web App
projects.details:
A web-based lost and found management system.
Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.
Includes practical features to support lost-item reporting and management.

projects.title: AI-Generated Text Detection using BERT and DistilBERT
projects.details:
Fine-tuned transformer-based models for binary text classification.
Implemented preprocessing, tokenization, and model evaluation pipelines.
Compared BERT and DistilBERT architectures using accuracy, precision, and F1-score.

projects.title: Explainable Lightweight Deep Learning for Common Skin Disease Classification in Low-Resource Clinical Environments
projects.details:
Developed a lightweight MobileNetV3-based skin disease classifier and compared it with two other models.
Applied transfer learning and adapted the final classification layer to the target dataset.
Integrated Grad-CAM to explain predictions and support model interpretability.

projects.title: An Explainable Multi-Task Approach to Vehicle Classification and Localization on Bangladeshi Roads Using VGG16 and ResNet18
projects.details:
Built an end-to-end multi-task model for vehicle classification and localization using the Sorokh-Poth Bangladeshi road vehicle dataset.
Used pretrained VGG16 and ResNet18 convolutional neural networks as base models.
Applied Grad-CAM visualizations to make model predictions easier to interpret.

projects.title: Fake News Detection using Naive Bayes
projects.details:
Applied TF-IDF feature extraction for text vectorization.
Implemented probabilistic classification using Naive Bayes.
Evaluated model performance using standard classification metrics.

projects.title: Computer Graphics: Village View
projects.details:
Developed a graphical simulation using C++ and OpenGL.
Implemented rendering techniques, geometric transformations, and animation logic.
Applied computer graphics pipeline concepts to construct the scene.

projects.title: Hostel Management System (C#)
projects.details:
Designed and implemented a role-based management system.
Applied object-oriented design principles and modular architecture.

projects.title: Bus Ticket Management System (Java)
projects.details:
Developed a structured ticket management application.
Applied object-oriented programming concepts and system modularization.

projects.title: Enhancement on Pathao App
projects.details:
Suggested enhancements to the Pathao app.
Prepared the project planning for the proposed improvements.

projects.title: Arduino-Based Smart Mop/Brush Cleaner Robot
projects.details:
Developed an autonomous four-wheel-drive cleaning robot using an Arduino Uno and L293D shield.
Integrated an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor on a servo motor for 180-degree obstacle scanning and real-time path planning.
Programmed a backward-then-soft-left navigation algorithm with averaged distance sensing to reduce noise and support smooth movement.

projects.title: Arduino-Based Fire & Smoke Detection System
projects.details:
Designed an Arduino Uno safety system with real-time audible and visual alerts.
Integrated infrared flame and MQ-2 gas sensors to detect fire and flammable smoke.
Built an I2C alert interface with an active buzzer and 16×2 LCD.
Developed embedded C++ logic with custom thresholds and active-low signal processing.

projects.title: Rain Detection and Alarming Using 555 Timer IC
projects.details:
Designed a rain detection system using a 555 Timer IC in astable mode to trigger an audible alarm.
Used a BC547 transistor switching circuit to connect the rain sensor to the timer RESET pin.
Selected resistor and capacitor values to produce a consistent 0.72 Hz alert frequency.

projects.title: Design and Implementation of a DC Mobile Charger with Fast Charging
projects.details:
Built an adjustable power supply using a DC buck-boost module for voltage and current regulation.
Implemented pulse-based switching with an LM555 Timer and complementary transistors.
Constructed a full-wave bridge rectifier with a smoothing capacitor to convert AC mains to stable DC.
